points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean f06ea3f source builds in restricted cfd-bench with bundled dependencies; all three CTests pass (unit and two mesh-inspection tests).

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/inspect and restart; output.cpp:280–296 stores step, physical time, current and previous states in rank-local files. Restart requires the original MPI count.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates config, mesh, partition, physics, solver and output; report records future extension limits.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable wrapper found; external authorship/similarity investigation was not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp loads JSON case configuration and CGNS mesh paths; no two-filename-only case branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:121–132 partitions on root, distributes then resets all global partition objects before solve. METIS/neighbor halos and rank evidence exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: State positivity scaling and error checks exist; no production rerun or independent stress campaign was performed.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Three clean CTests pass: unit and NACA/cylinder mesh inspections; no unsteady solver rerun. Historical validator and rank packages are preserved.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is organized; curated report omits escaped PNG assets despite an accepted original workspace PDF.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible perfect-gas NS and reference normalization implemented and described.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Root-only CGNS mesh/partition setup and clean NACA/cylinder mesh inspection tests support imported geometry.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual is assembled conservatively; actual final runs show strong reductions but startup-compressed force figures and single-mesh uncertainty remain.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov steady and HLLC transient with fallback are implemented and disclosed; no independent higher-order flux comparison.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield/slip/no-slip paths exist and solver.cpp:370–371 explicitly sets wall velocity to zero.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Weighted least-squares reconstruction and production limiter are source-supported; no evaluator production rerun or grid-convergence test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter and positivity controls are implemented; fallback counters and bounded shock tests reported.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:393–403 explicitly subtracts the normal component of wall viscous traction before integrated force; cf uses tangential component at :407–411.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Block-Jacobi pseudo-time and force/residual gates are implemented; first five historical cases use 9e89a35 plateau-tolerance code, differing from later source.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 inner residual ratio is tested against strict target; workspace metadata reports final0.000942283 and zero misses, force/wake data support periodicity. Exact executable unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Re20 np1/2/8 final Cd agrees within ~1e−14 at step3846; M015 rank runs agree closely but np8 metadata names earlier plateau-source revision.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight production packages and report historically pass structural validation; accepted PDF and raw histories checked, while exact executable and all figure bindings remain qualified.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical explicit validator passes eight case directories and report. Structural pass is not a numerical accuracy or executable-identity proof.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reaches t300 with strict target metadata and resolved forces. Steady final200 forces are bounded; M015 drag changes 2.6% relative near zero.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.03576 and Re200 mean Cd1.26946 with lift amplitude0.567 and period≈5.37 are physically plausible; no grid refinement supplied.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All13 accepted PDF pages inspected; case histories/near-body fields and readable Re200 late-force inset/wake are delivered. Several steady force panels compress startup.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Readable 13-page accepted workspace PDF supplies numeric summaries, figures and limitations, while curated TeX cannot independently include omitted figures.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace manifest and selected final response identify figures/results. Metadata revision9e89a35 differs in plateau tolerance from final source for first five cases; exact executables and all individual figure bindings unbound.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean restricted build and three unit/mesh-inspection CTests pass; rank-local restart retains step/time and both BDF states but requires the same MPI count.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: General CGNS unstructured multi-zone topology and graph construction.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual, flux and boundary-condition evidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Limited weighted least-squares reconstruction and positivity control.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier and explicitly tangential integrated wall traction at solver.cpp:393–403.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2 histories, strict target ratio and observed periodic Re200 evidence checked; no solver rerun.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, neighbor halos, reductions and np1/2/8 comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight delivered results and figures are credible with qualified source provenance; M015 inviscid Cd changes 2.6% relative near zero over final200.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted workspace PDF includes readable case figures, but curated TeX omits figure blobs and cannot reproduce those images alone.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Clear modular interfaces, while three-dimensional elements, RANS, chemistry and general EOS remain future extensions.
